correctness.rationale: For M=2^e, e>=2, pairing i and M-i gives P_e(A)=G(M^2 A(A+1)), with m=2^(e-2) odd pair-constants c_r=i_r(M-i_r). A dyadic congruence f(r+2^k)=f(r) mod 2^(k+2) for f=c_r^(-1) yields v2(sum_r 1/c_r)=e-2. Consequently v2(G' (0))=e-2 and the divided-difference quotient at T_A,T_B in 2^(2e+1)Z has that exact valuation. Factoring T_A-T_B proves v2(P_e(A)-P_e(B))=3e-2+v2((A-B)(A+B+1)); the zero factors are actual equalities. The two factors have odd sum, so modulo 2^s they give exactly distinct reflected two-point fibers; odd products congruent modulo 4 give exactly +j valuation on 2^j powers. Independently computed 384 nontrivial exact pairs at e=2..7 and shifts -4..4; finite checks do not prove the universal law.
